heading: Frequently Asked Questions
text2: Quick answers to the questions we hear most about this service.

items.question: Is PHP still a good choice?
items.answer: Yes. Modern PHP is fast, secure and well supported, with strong frameworks and tooling.

items.question: Which PHP frameworks do you use?
items.answer: Laravel and CodeIgniter, chosen according to the project.

items.question: Can you upgrade my old PHP site?
items.answer: Yes. We can modernize code, improve security and speed, and move it to current PHP.

items.question: How long does php web development take?
items.answer: A business website usually takes 4 to 8 weeks, while custom web applications take 3 to 6 months depending on features and integrations.

items.question: Do you offer support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We provide maintenance, updates, monitoring and new feature development after launch.
